meta.notes: Accelerator that invests via convertible note (FAQ: EUR 45,000 in-kind program plus optional EUR 25,000 cash; ~5% equity target); ticket set to the optional cash part only. Legal entity is a per-batch SPV (Batch 15 s.r.o.; other batches 5-14 have separate IČOs); no entity named plain StartupYard found; registry via tier-3 mirror, not ARES. Only one dated deal found (Ydoca, 2025-02-14, CZK 500k, instrument not stated, so unknown); the page says the 2025 cohort deals incl. Personeo.ai/Wopee.io have no investment statement. Batch 15 announcement (2025-09-11 per news archive) page prints no date; the sector quote date comes from the news archive listing. Founder blog posts Teamsharq (2026-06-15) and CaseLens (2026-04-30) do not state investment. Possible grant_or_program_only borderline: in-kind program, but cash convertible investment exists.
